environment: preserve complete canonical state; compare all prescribed environmental fields to frozen07/08, exclude derived AirDensity
cycle_selection: StartOfInhale rising edge; last10 complete cycles; no phase substitution if markers absent; report first/last and full raw series

stability_candidate.status: ENGINEERING_HYPOTHESIS_PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL; failed check stops reference adoption, no retry

reference_method.pressure: min/max across selected full-cycle raw0.02s samples, pad1cmH2O each side
reference_method.volume: min/max across same cycles, pad0.1*pooled healthy mean mL each side
reference_method.phase: preserve inhale/exhale boundaries; report per-cycle extrema, means, periods; do not tune to injured result
reference_method.comparability: same patient/engine/boundary conditions; age and version alone insufficient

events: every step complete active set and duration; initialset+transitions; phase markers preserved
failure_policy: stop; keep raw failure; no automatic retry/extension
